physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the throat, and more specifically in the thyroid, the small gland riding low at the base of the neck that sets the tempo of everything else in the body. It is fitting. This is the code of the voice, of the word that influences a room, and it sits in the gland that decides how loud or quiet the body's whole machinery runs underneath that voice. The upper trigram is Lake, the mouth of the body where the inner pools finally meet the air, and the lower is Mountain, the still ground the speaking rises from. The shape of the card is already the shape of the throat.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. Arrogance, in this card, is not first a personality. It is a thyroid running hot, a voice produced faster than the ground can catch up with, words coming out ahead of the slower truth behind them. There is a heat at the front of the neck when this happens. The deferring kind has the opposite weather, a swallowing, a tightness, a held-back gland running cool.

The climb out is also bodily. The voice slows. The breath finds the gland before the gland finds the words. What comes out then carries the body's actual tempo, and the room can feel it. Leadership at this level is metabolic. The throat has stopped working ahead of the rest of you.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to a single amino acid, Tyrosine. Tyrosine is the raw material the thyroid pulls out of the blood and stitches together with iodine to make the hormone that paces the whole body. Without it the gland has nothing to build with. The voice that this card is so concerned with is, lower down, a chemical signal made from this one letter.

There is a teaching in that. Tyrosine is also the seed the body uses to make dopamine and adrenaline, the molecules of wanting and the molecules of pushing. The same letter that builds the tempo of the body also builds the urge to be noticed. The shadow of this card and the gift of this card are made from the same chemistry. They are not different substances. They are different uses of the same one.

The code runs all the way to this. What you speak from is what you are made of, and what you are made of can serve fear or serve the room. The chemistry is neutral. The frequency is the choice.
